_validation_rules.description: Schema validation MUST be enforced on all POST/PUT payloads before persistence to lowdb
implementation_required: Validate incoming JSON against this schema before persisting
Reject payloads with unexpected property types or structures
Use ajv or similar JSON Schema validator to enforce constraints
Return 400 Bad Request with validation error details on schema violations
Log validation failures for security auditing
_validation_rules.example_validation_code: import Ajv from 'ajv'; const ajv = new Ajv(); const validate = ajv.compile(schema); if (!validate(incomingPayload)) { throw new Error(`Invalid payload: ${JSON.stringify(validate.errors)}`); }
